pages.text: Cast a line into $(l)Lumenwater$(/l) for a catch found nowhere else — native fish and flora, glowing materials, and rare treasure on top of your normal haul.
Rarest of all are enchanted $(l)spell-books$(/l) carrying Lumenwilds enchantments — the $(o)only$() way to get them. Apply them at an anvil.

Armor: $(l)Lightfooted$(/l) (boots, Lightfoot), $(l)Nightsight$(/l) (helmet, night vision), $(l)Lumenward$(/l) (chest, water breathing + dolphin's grace).$(br)Weapons: $(l)Glowbrand$(/l) (Glowmarked on hit), $(l)Sporestrike$(/l) (Sporeblind), $(l)Rootbinding$(/l) (Rooted).
